name: cm-reporting-integration
description: Codex plugin for integrating and operating the cm-reporting React component library.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate cm-reporting in host React apps
interface.longDescription: Use this plugin to integrate cm-reporting with template delivery, Snapshot persistence, Excel export, external pickers, readOnly behavior, and legacy adapter flows.
defaultPrompt: Use $cm-reporting-integration to wire cm-reporting into my React app.
Use $cm-reporting-integration to add Snapshot save, restore, and Excel export.
Use $cm-reporting-integration to review my readOnly integration behavior.
